name: Archaic Rune

angles.text: As a shaman, the Archaic Rune marks the first step in your spiritual journey. It confirms your elemental attunement and introduces you to your primary mentor.
As a dwarf, you see the Archaic Rune mark an exchange between clans. The Wildhammer share their ancient spiritual traditions with their Bronzebeard kin in Coldridge Valley.
As an Alliance member, you see Wildhammer mentors bring shamanic arts to Dun Morogh, adding elemental traditions alongside the Holy Light.

faq.answer: The Archaic Rune is an ancient stone tablet marked with old Wildhammer script and elemental power. Promising newcomers in Coldridge Valley receive it as their first test of spiritual potential. Reading it confirms an initiate’s calling to the shamanic path and points them to the trainer in Anvilmar.

The Archaic Rune bears inscriptions in the traditional style of the Wildhammer clan. Teo Hammerstorm, a Wildhammer shaman in Anvilmar, sent it to find new initiates with an innate connection to the elemental spirits.

Teo Hammerstorm is a Wildhammer dwarf and shaman trainer in Anvilmar, in Coldridge Valley. He has traveled to Dun Morogh to share his clan’s ancestral shamanic teachings with the Bronzebeard dwarves, guiding new practitioners in earth, fire, water, and air.

The Wildhammer kept the shamanic arts largely within their clan for many years. Now Bronzebeard dwarves practice those elemental ways too. Mentors such as Teo Hammerstorm teach Ironforge dwarves to commune with and honor the elemental spirits.
faq.q: Why are Wildhammer teachings being shared with Bronzebeard dwarves?

aliases: where to turn in archaic rune
faq.answer: Bring the rune to Teo Hammerstorm inside Anvilmar’s main lodge in Coldridge Valley. Presenting it shows you can channel the elements and opens further training in fundamental shamanic spells.
faq.q: Where do I take the Archaic Rune?

aliases: why can i read the rune
faq.answer: The Archaic Rune holds elemental energy and bears ancient dwarven script. Only an initiate attuned to the elemental forces can read it. Success confirms an adventurer’s calling to the shamanic path and readiness to become a shaman.
faq.q: What does reading the rune signify?

sections.body: Near Anvilmar, you find the Archaic Rune after aiding local allies in Coldridge Valley. Its markings follow the Wildhammer style, and elemental power courses through the stone. The inscription tests whether you can sense the primordial spirits. Read it, and the rune directs you to proper instruction at the nearby dwarven outpost.
sections.title: An Ancient Inscription

sections.body: In Anvilmar’s great hall, Teo Hammerstorm receives the inscribed stone. For generations, the Wildhammer kept the spiritual arts of the elements largely within their clan among the windswept peaks. Now these traditions are taking root among the Bronzebeard dwarves of Ironforge and Dun Morogh. Teo bridges the two dwarven cultures, welcoming young initiates called to commune with the elements and teaching them earth, air, fire, and water.
sections.title: Wildhammer Wisdom in Dun Morogh

summary: In Coldridge Valley, young dwarf Shamans begin learning the elements through an ancient rune. It leads them to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar for instruction in earth, air, fire, and water.
